prompt: Review this PR: it rewords two log messages in src/jobs/cleanup.ts ("cleanup done" becomes "cleanup finished, 12 rows removed") and fixes a typo in a comment.

requiredBehaviors: check that the new message reads the count from the real value and not a constant
keep the review short and approve when nothing is wrong
forbiddenBehaviors: run a try-to-break-it pass with boundary, concurrency or timezone attacks on a log-message change
list attacks that held for a low-risk diff
